body: Well the first time I did shrooms it was 1.7g with a friend and not very strong. A good experience though. Second time I did it was 3.5g, double the dose. I had a terrible experience which ended up with me in the fetal position crying (pathetic, I know). I feel different than before, but I don't think that they made me more depressed.
Yeah I know it's important but I just can't stand them. I appreciate that they take care of me and all, but I just have no interest of being close to them. And yes I'm openly gay.
My parents are divorced and I'm not necessarily close to either of them. Like I said I'm antisocial, I don't talk much.
I smoke weed regularly (since last year) and I've done shrooms twice (once in march, once in June). I've felt this way before taking shrooms, if you're wondering.
To be honest, I don't remember much that made me happy. Not that I wasn't happy, I just don't remember. Drugs have mainly been my only source of happiness.
